question: Which among the following is NOT an example of matter?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Gravity.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gravity **is a fundamental interaction which causes mutual attraction between all things with mass or energy.
 
• Hence it is not matter.
 
• Matters are generally categorized into 3 states:
 
 
• Solid: 
 
 
• Particles are held very close to each other and can't move. 
 
• Solid ice, sugar, rock, wood.
 
 
 
• Liquid: 
 
 
• Particles are close to each other but they can move around. 
 
• Water, **Raindrops **and oil.
 
 
 
• Gas: 
 
 
• Particles are far from each other as compared to those present in solid or liquid states and their movement is easy and fast.
 
• **Clouds**, ​Oxygen, carbon dioxide, nitrogen, hydrogen, helium, steam.
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] Confusion Points__

 
• **Fire **is a 'matter' because it occupies space and since it is a mixture of gases, it must have some mass.
